function f(k: number) {
  const o = { [k]: "hello" };
  const s: string = o.foo;
  console.log(s.toUpperCase());
}
f(1);
function g(k: number) {
  const o = { [k]: 42 } as const;
  const n: number = o.foo;
  console.log(n.toFixed());
}
g(0);
function h(k: number, a: any) {
  const named = { [k]: 1, x: "s", 2: true };
  const fromNumber: number = named[k];
  const fromAny = { [a.key]: 1 };
  console.log(named.y, fromAny.y, fromNumber);
  const methods = {
    [k + 1]() {
      return 1;
    },
  };
  const m: () => string = methods[0];
}
